stage: Frozen before inspection of any enlarged-campaign BBC support or corrected contrasts; native photon simulations running.
primary_native_options: Released opt_biascor=4336; native code adds documented MAD bit. Preserve SNR>60 intrinsic scatter minimum50, min_per_cell_biascor, MUCOV counts, fieldgroups, z/x1/c/host grid and interpolation gates. No relaxation.

training_targets.literal: Retain generated SIM_gammaDM. Native direct-MU target subtracts this known imposed intrinsic grey term, so its retention in output is partly definitional.
training_targets.retained_age: Derived training-only table sets SIM_gammaDM=0 while preserving original TRUE_AGE_MAGSHIFT. All photon data, observed fits, SIM_DLMAG and evaluation remain unchanged. This alternative makes the mean-map target retain the unknown imposed grey term; it also changes native global gamma centering and may change MUCOV calibration.

nuisance_semantics: Dust mode replaces training SIM_ALPHA and SIM_BETA by fixed map-construction p1=.15,p2=2.87 and uses one correction cell despite floating final alpha/beta. Frozen nuisance response must use the same native map externally, not rebuild it by changing p1/p2.
cases: age evaluation with nominal map and externally frozen nominal fitted alpha/beta/gamma
age evaluation with nominal correction and nuisance refit
age evaluation with age-trained literal correction and nuisance refit
age evaluation with age-trained retained-age correction and nuisance refit
primary_quantity: BBC MU minus generated SIM_DLMAG, with one common-support weighted global offset removed for each contrast; never subtract per-redshift-bin M0DIF. MURES is not the drift statistic. Check MU−MUMODEL=MURES+M0DIF and reconstruct native MU from x0, alpha,beta,gamma, mass logistic, biasCor_mu and one global offset.
comparisons: Use exactly common retained evaluation occurrence IDs for each paired comparison. Report native-selection counts and common support separately. Slopes control for supported redshift-bin intercepts; no true age enters distance fitting.
support: At least10 common retained events per reported redshift bin, at least30 for slope; unsupported bins are null. Report all native rejection and MUCOV gates, never impute missing correction.
uncertainty: Native statistical covariance is conditional on constructed maps, fixed population and simulated cadence. Planned paired bootstrap resamples generated training attempts and evaluation attempts independently, sharing resampling across nominal/injected counterparts, and reruns native BBC; report failed/unsupported replicates and Monte Carlo precision. Bootstrap target200 replicates after supported baseline exists; scale by measured native runtime. One-bin alpha/beta maps remain fixed at declared construction values.
normalization_sensitivity: Also use SIM_DLMAG+5log10[dL(zHD)/dL(SIM_ZCMB)] from the declared BBC cosmology, matching native training target. Lensing remains simulated photon scatter, not an extra true-distance term.
limits: This is not the unavailable original Dovekie mock realizations
